scorer.note: the runner records the resolved checkpoint path, size and SHA-256 in every output

observation.note: frozen convention; the band is never narrowed to hide filter loss

null_variation.rule: baseline render-seed split half, clustered at recording level, one-sided upper bound

regimes.note: held-out duration frozen at 4s because updown_nosource_room2 and spinning_nosource_room2 each supply exactly 4s of disjoint cruise support after the 16s fit window and guard margins; 8s is unavailable for the full five-recording cohort

provenance.note: DECLARED: this legacy export carries no data block. It names one recording only, so it cannot cover the five-recording cohort by identity and is reported ineligible rather than cycled.

regimes.family_note: only one standby export exists (results/S2/standby.json, raw era), so there is nothing to select between

regimes.note: FLY124 ramp is ONE fixed-event point benchmark: ~0.99s of 45-65 rev/s material inside an 8s context window; the scored support is the pre-registered ramp interval, not the whole window

provenance.note: DECLARED: legacy export, no data block. Starts taken from the refined-era export's identical window grid; Main must confirm before freezing.

ACCEPTED conservative envelope: whole known standby event [1.78, 15.28]s. Exact start unknown; this is the declared training provenance for the raw-era standby export. Calibration fits may use any non-overlapping [2,10]-style standby support; do not force a refit or drop the regime.
